address: 27 Albemarle Street, Mayfair, London, W1S 4HZ, United Kingdom
bio: Given its name – which translates as ‘leopard’ – it’s not hard to guess that this chic Mayfair operation specialises in classic Italian cuisine. Thankfully, this is a leopard that won’t change its spots, serving time-honoured dishes cooked in the traditional Italian way, with quality ingredients and plenty of flavour. Sharing is encouraged and given the generosity of dishes like the veal Milanese, it’s probably a good idea. All of this comes wrapped up in elegant surroundings, whether you’re sat in the main room, on the light-filled terrace or by the crudo bar....
